page.overview:
Who is Finn Edwards?

Finn Edwards, the Bootlegger, is a fictional character created by Fantasy Flight Games who appears in several of their expanded Cthulhu Mythos lines.

The advent of Prohibition was nothing less than a godsend for small-time drifter Finn Edwards: until that point, he had been simply meandering through life, scratching out a living wherever he could, but the new demand for alcohol on the streets of America gave him the opportunity to make some serious money and, more importantly, feed his craving for danger.

All of this ended one night when, after a botched supply run, Finn found himself tearing through the woods one moonlit night, just a little ahead of the deranged cultists who wanted to sacrifice him to their dark god.

Narrowly escaping, and shaken to his core, Finn gathered up all the cash, firearms and supplies he could lay his hands on, resolving to make those lunatics pay for giving him the fright of his life.
